mapper.select: select e.id, e.username, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.job, e.salary, e.image, e.entry_date, e.dept_id, d.name as deptName from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.id order by e.id

select e.*, d.name as deptName, ee.id as ee_id, ee.emp_id as ee_emp_id, ee.begin as ee_begin, ee.end as ee_end, ee.company as ee_company, ee.job as ee_job from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.id left join emp_expr ee on e.id = ee.emp_id where e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into emp(username, password, name, gender, phone, job, salary, image, entry_date, dept_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{job}, #{salary}, #{image}, #{entryDate}, #{deptId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
